label: Limited rear visibility due to thick pillars and small windows
symptom: Reduced view over the shoulder due to thick rear pillars and small rear side windows, making exiting junctions or parking tricky.
cause: Vehicle design with thick C-pillars and limited glass area.
fix: Use mirrors carefully, consider aftermarket blind-spot mirrors.
inspection_advice: Check visibility during test drive, especially over-the-shoulder checks.
notes: Merged from 'Small rear side windows' and 'Seriously limited rear visibility' and 'Poor rear visibility and blind spots' issues.

inspection_advice: Test drive at highway speeds to assess cabin noise levels.

label: Timing chain stretch, tensioner failure, or jump
symptom: Engine locks up due to timing chain failure causing piston-to-valve contact. Issues with chain stretch or tensioners can occur.
cause: Timing chain stretch, tensioner failure, or chain jump.
fix: Replace timing chain and tensioner assembly.
inspection_advice: Listen for timing chain rattle at cold start. Check service history for chain replacement.
notes: Reported on H4BT/0.9 TCE engine. Less frequent than some other engines but can cause catastrophic failure.

label: Interior wears poorly and rattles
symptom: The interior doesn't wear too well, with the steering wheel, gear knob and gear gaiter being common areas, and it rattles quite a bit.
cause: Material degradation and poor build quality
fix: Replace worn components (steering wheel, gear knob) and address rattles with insulation or tightening
warning_signs: ["Steering wheel degradation", "Gear knob wear", "Persistent interior rattles"]
inspection_advice: Check steering wheel and gear knob for excessive wear. Test drive on rough roads for rattles.
notes: Steering wheel degradation specifically mentioned as rapid.

label: Exhaust system and rubbers fail early

fix: Replace exhaust system components and upgrade exhaust rubbers
inspection_advice: Inspect exhaust for rust, especially at joints and silencers. Check rubber hangers for cracking.
notes: Combines exhaust system and rubber failures as related exhaust issues.
